data.title: Methotrexate gel (0.25%)
data.body:
_Topicals · IX Immunomodulators_

**Class:** Topical antifolate

## Mechanism of action
- Inhibits dihydrofolate reductase in keratinocytes and lymphocytes → antiproliferative and anti-inflammatory
- Penetration through thick psoriatic plaques is limited (hydrophilic molecule) — hence modest efficacy; gel/hydrophilic or liposomal bases improve delivery

## Indications in dermatology & STI
- Localised plaque psoriasis (palmoplantar, limited plaques) — available in India
- Off-label: nail psoriasis, vitiligo (limited evidence)

## Dose & formulations
- Apply once or twice daily to plaques; avoid normal skin

## Adverse effects
- Local irritation, erythema
- Systemic toxicity is unlikely but possible with extensive use on broken skin

## Contraindications
- Pregnancy; large or eroded areas

## Pregnancy & lactation
Avoid.

## Viva points
- Topical MTX is limited by poor penetration
- Indian product; evidence base is small

_Sources: Wolverton 4e ch.14 (MTX — topical forms mentioned); Khopkar (topical immunomodulators); Indian studies. Facts summarised in our own words; Wolverton followed where books differ._
